REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - JULY 31, 2018 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA
90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1203. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to
the Property Preservation Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.
